units.source_text: 三条把遇见右近之事告诉了乳母，闻者皆大吃惊。

en.t: Sanjo told the nurse about meeting Ukon, and everyone who heard it was greatly astonished.

units.source_text: 乳母说：“我真觉得同做梦一样！

en.t: The nurse said, "I truly feel as if I am dreaming!

units.source_text: 当年她把夫人带走，我恨煞了她，

en.t: Back then, when she took my lady away, I hated her bitterly,

units.source_text: 不料今天在这里和她见面。”

en.t: yet unexpectedly I have met her here today."
Then she went toward the room next door.

units.source_text: 她们把隔开两房间的屏风全部取去，以便畅叙。

en.t: They removed all the screens separating the two rooms so they could talk freely.

units.source_text: 两人一见，一句话也不说，首先相向而哭。

en.t: When the two saw each other, they said nothing at first, but faced one another and wept.

units.source_text: 后来老太太好容易说话了：“夫人怎么样了？

en.t: After a while, the old woman finally managed to speak: "What has become of my lady?

units.source_text: 多年以来，我常想知道她的下落，即使在梦中得知也好。

en.t: For many years I have longed to know where she was, even if I could learn it only in a dream.

units.source_text: 因此对神明许下宏誓大愿。

en.t: For that reason I made great vows and prayers to the gods.

units.source_text: 然而我远居他乡，一点风声也传不过来，实在悲伤之极！

en.t: But I lived far away in another place, and not the slightest rumor reached me, which was unbearably sad!
I have grown old without dying, and I feel my life is empty.

units.source_text: 只因夫人所舍弃的小女公子，已经长得非常可爱可怜。

en.t: It is only because the little young lady whom my lady left behind has grown so dear and pitiful.

units.source_text: 我倘舍弃了她而死，到冥司也得受罪，因此还在这里偷生。”

en.t: If I abandoned her and died, I would suffer punishment even in the underworld, and so I still cling to life here."

units.source_text: 右近无法作答，因为她觉得向她报告夕颜死耗，

en.t: Ukon could not answer, because she felt that telling her of Yugao's death

units.source_text: 比昔年束手眼看夕颜暴死更加痛苦。

en.t: was even more painful than helplessly watching Yugao die so suddenly in the past.
Yet in the end she had no choice but to say, "Alas!

units.source_text: 告诉你也是枉然，夫人早已不在了！”

en.t: There is no use in telling you, but my lady has long since passed away!"

units.source_text: 此言一出，三人齐声啜泣，眼泪流个不住。

en.t: As soon as these words were spoken, the three of them sobbed together, and their tears would not stop flowing.
